issue_request: FHIR-16884 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary correction asking that the Code System - bundleType page stop showing a value-set registry link label while pointing users at the code-system registry.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot records Grahame Grieve's comment that the issue was already fixed. No FHIR-16884-keyed implementation commit was found, but current branch history introduced the active CodeSystem template with the corrected code-system registry text and terminologies-systems.html link.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini and the bundle-type CodeSystem source remains under source/bundle. The current active CodeSystem template is corrected; an unreferenced legacy template-cs-book.html still contains value-set wording, and old STU3/2018May rendered pages still show the historical wording, but neither is a current-source reason to edit this issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source for generated CodeSystem pages already satisfies the issue request, and editing an unreferenced book template would exceed the current build-scope threshold for this reconciliation.
